verdict.rationale: 1Password documents exporting your information from its apps to move to a different app, and the CLI and SDKs offer programmatic item access that could support extraction. The evidence does not name the export formats, does not say whether every item type and attachment is included, and cites CSV and the Credential Exchange standard only for import, not export. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/CXF), confirmation that export covers all data including attachments and passkeys, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
